tips.text: Run Elite Sanctuary Onslaught with a nuke frame, leave around round 8 and repeat to fill the daily cap.
Run the New Loka alerts solo; squads rush extraction and joining mid-mission loses Seeds already picked up.
Switch to Red Veil once New Loka and Perrin are done; it touches neither and you can swap back later.
Buy everything you want from New Loka before you pledge elsewhere; standing drains afterward.
Rank up as soon as you can afford it; standing past a rank maximum is wasted.
The MR 12 gate is a bigger hurdle than the standing, which most players finish alongside Perrin.
